title: School Completion Rates by State
description: Proportion of students who complete primary, lower secondary, and upper secondary education at national and state level.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia for national-level data

fields.name: stage
fields.title: School Stage
fields.description: [Categorical] Either primary (Standards 1 to 6), lower secondary (Form 1 to 3), or upper secondary (Form 4 to 5)

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes, male, or female

fields.name: completion
fields.title: Completion Rate
fields.description: [Float] Proportion of students who complete that stage of education, relative to the total cohort that started that stage

methodology: This dataset is derived from administrative records maintained by the Ministry of Education Malaysia via the Education Management Information System (EMIS). Completion rates are calculated by comparing the number of students who complete a given education level with the total cohort that started that level.
caveat: Because Malaysia's dropout rates are extremely low, completion rates may exceed 100% due to a small number of students repeating grades or transferring between states. Furthermore, it should be noted that the data refers to government schools only.
